description: Source code for the TensorFlowYoloDetector class, implementing object detection using TensorFlow with a YOLO model in an Android environment.

classes.name: TensorFlowYoloDetector

methods.description: Factory method to initialize and configure the detector instance with model parameters, asset manager, and input settings.
